clips.title: The story
paras: Agents of the Argent Dawn seek Kelris's severed head to confirm his fall and the end of his sacrifices.

In Blackfathom Deeps, Twilight Lord Kelris led sacrifices to Aku'mai, a monstrous servant of an Old God. Taking his head marks the end of his rule over the Twilight's Hammer cultists and their naga allies in the cavern. The head must reach the surface so leaders can know his bloody ceremonies have ended.

The Argent Dawn had presumed Kelris dead or lost for months before his influence returned with Kalimdor's encroaching shadows. His head, brought to agents in Darnassus or Thunder Bluff, settles lingering bounties and confirms that his attempt to plunge the world into primeval chaos has been stopped.
